subject.title: fix(zalo): prevent Bot API requests from hanging

question: What supported timeout should existing Zalo hosted-media sends receive when the shared Bot API boundary gains a default deadline?
rationale: The code can mechanically apply a chosen policy, but neither the Zalo API contract nor the submitted proof establishes that 30 seconds is safe for current media-delivery workflows.

options.title: Approve 30 seconds for all calls
options.body: Accept the compatibility change only after Zalo-area review and real slow-media proof show that a 30-second request window is supported.

options.title: Use a media-specific supported deadline
options.body: Keep the shared hang protection while giving `sendPhoto` an owner-approved longer deadline and regression coverage for both normal and slow media delivery.

options.title: Pause the default-timeout change
options.body: Keep the current explicit-timeout behavior until the provider's delivery timing contract is understood.

recommendation.title: Use a media-specific supported deadline
recommendation.body: Keep the shared hang protection while giving `sendPhoto` an owner-approved longer deadline and regression coverage for both normal and slow media delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Listed package collaboration makes this the strongest available routing signal for the Zalo delivery policy decision.
